details.text: The jira specification file appears to be out of date with the versions, artifacts and pages currently defined in the IG.  A proposed revised file to be reviewed and, if appropriate, submitted as a pull request against the XML folder in https://github.com/HL7/JIRA-Spec-Artifacts.  To see the differences, perform a file compare on 'template/jira-current.xml' (a normalized view of what is in Github) and 'template/jira-new.xml' (reflects current IG content)
In your menu.xml file, it's no longer allowed to have href='#' on dropdown items.  Change them to be href='menu.html' instead.  (It won't link, but it needs to be something valid.)
